The published bytes must pass one fresh permanent-ID canary and independent review before the one-shot fetch. A successful fetch remains active_pending_independent_review until a durable independent review is hashed into one authoritative state.close event; a failed fetch is never retried and its existing closed_failed state is only verified, never closed twice.
